title: John 1 in the RSV identifies the Word with God and with the beginning
summary: The RSV of John 1:1 says the Word was with God and the Word was God.
body: The Revised Standard Version of John 1:1 says the Word was in the beginning, the Word was with God, and the Word was God. Later Christian creeds argue from this sentence. The card stores the sentence, not a council's definition. The wording on the page includes: "CNVT CSBS CSBT CUVS CUV CUVMPS CUVMPT RCU17SS RCU17TS Update The Word Became Flesh 1 In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. 2 He was in the beginning with God; 3 all things were made through him, and without him was not anything made that was made. 4 In him was life,[a] and the life was the light of men. 5 The light shines in the". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
